name: dense-source
description: Dense but accurate prose lacks orientation and defines a key term late. Stage test-files/ as a separate workspace root outside any SKILL.md ancestor. The editor sees only those files and the target skill; oracle/ is grader-only.
prompt: /kk:clarify-docs guide.md for restaurant owners. Use requirements.md and prep.py as evidence; edit only guide.md.
trap: Reorders prose fluently without reading implementation, loses zero overrides or implies existing orders update.

assertions.text: All five reader answers in oracle/expected.json are supported by the revised guide alone.

Fidelity: retain null/missing inheritance, explicit zero, live inherited lookup, immutable order snapshot, identifiers, scheduling exclusion and the product owner's open badge decision; add no unsupported behavior.
The editor trace shows full shared instructions loaded before guide/source reads and inspection of both requirements.md and prep.py before editing.

Orientation: explain the restaurant-owner purpose before storage identifiers, define snapshot/materialization at first use, and explicitly work through inherited item, zero override and existing order across a 15-to-20 default change.
Only guide.md changes; no additional ledger or summary artifact is created.
